changes.title: No end cards
items: No more end cards: after a night is won or lost, the pointer leads you home instead (to the map table if you found a new island, then to bed)

changes.title: Forest fade
items: In the treehouse the forest fades in behind every room over 20 seconds once the island has loaded, and stays
Until then it's dark behind the whole house, the Terrace too; the fade's length is on the pause page (Oak crown)

changes.title: Audio test
items: The pause page has an Audio test button: a two-minute check of how much sound your machine can play, with results to copy for the builders
